The '''Woodskip''' is a [[fish]] that can be caught in the pond in the [[Secret Woods]] during any season. It is most prevalent there on non-rainy days, with each cast having a 15% to 27% chance to hook a Woodskip depending on [[Skills#Fishing|fishing skill]]. The Woodskip is more likely to be caught when casting at least 3 tiles from shore.<ref name="spawnrate" /> It can also be caught on the [[Farm Maps#Forest|Forest Farm]], with each cast having a 0% to 17.5% chance to hook a Woodskip depending on daily [[luck]].<ref name="fish" /> It can also randomly be found at the [[Traveling Cart]] for {{tprice|75}}.

==Map==
The Woodskip can be found in the Secret Woods and the Forest Farm.

==Tailoring==
The Woodskip can be used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the [[Tailoring|Fishing Vest]].  [[File:Shirt157.png|24px]] It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as an orange dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].

==Fish Pond==
Woodskips can be placed in a [[Fish Pond]], where they will reproduce every 2 days. The initial pond capacity is 1 fish, but the capacity can be increased to 10 by completing four quests. Typical output includes orange Woodskip [[Roe]] and [[wood]], but other tree-related products are possible starting at population 6.

==Quests==
*Two Woodskip may be requested by [[Dorado]], [[Lingcod]], or [[Pike]] in a [[Fish Pond#Quests|Fish Pond quest]] to increase the capacity of the pond from 7 to 10.
